jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.zh: 全球本月疫情更新:  自2022年5月截至今年8/28累計139國/地區報告15萬8,000餘例確診病例,其中至少399例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第35週累計84國/地區報告3萬7千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬1,980例、美洲區2,825例、歐洲區1,858例、西太平洋區1,067例、東南亞區82例及東地中海區33例。西太平洋疫情上升,歸因於中國、菲律賓今年7月單月新增皆逾100例病例。  其他更新:   肯亞疫情上升,自2024年7月報告首例病例截至今年8/17累計370例確診,其中6例死亡,死亡個案中有5例為HIV患者。病患多集中於該國東南方第二大港口城市蒙巴薩,病患過半數為20-40歲年輕人,該國近45%縣(21/47)皆報告病例,性接觸傳播為主要擴大因素,尤其是東非主要跨國公路之卡車司機、性工作者及商販等。 中國於8/1報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,於7月中旬入境時回報症狀,當局展開疫調並採防範措施。另澳門於8/27報告今年首例境外移入病例,為該區自2023年第3例病例(前2例於2023年報告)。病患為29歲澳門男性居民,於8/23出現發熱、咽痛及腹瀉等症狀,曾於內地就診,26日返澳就醫確診,病患曾在旅遊時發生高風險性行為,惟未透露地點。 德國於8/19報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已追蹤接觸者並監測症狀。 土耳其報告3例Ib型病例,近期報告1例為7月下旬時確診,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)及埃及旅遊史,餘2例為回溯型病例,具烏干達旅遊史,當局已採疫調及隔離相關措施。 剛果民主共和國首次報告2例IIb型確診病例,指標個案為成年男性,具象牙海岸旅遊史,經分析該序列與象牙海岸及奈及利亞之病例相;案2為指標個案之接觸者,當局匡列25名接觸者追蹤,其中23名接種暴露後疫苗。該國首次檢出IIb型病例,顯示IIb型已進入Ia/Ib型流行區域,公共風險增加。  評估與建議: WHO宣布原定於2025/8/20到期之長期建議措施,因應全球流行病學情勢,將再延長1年,以預防及減少國際傳播及其對健康之影響。強調「持續監測、科學研究、社區合作與公平資源分配」是2025–26年全球防控核心,7大面向建議包括:國家防治計畫與政策持續優化、建立監測與實驗室診斷能力、加強社區保護與風險溝通、推動研究與臨床試驗、制定旅行相關措施(不鼓勵旅行禁令)、提供最佳臨床照護與醫護防護、確保公平獲得疫苗/診斷/治療。
jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 March, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 4 in Somalia, and 1 each in Angola and Nigeria. For environmental samples, 12 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 7 countries: 5 in Yemen, 3 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Angola, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia and Somalia.

P_G83niooL3PfKouUpGBaA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/20-26期間,新增報告WPV1型巴基斯坦1例病例;cVDPV2型新增3國13例病例,分別為查德6例、衣索比亞5例、葉門2例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦13件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增6國10件,分別為德國4件、吉布地2件、查德/象牙海岸/波蘭/英國各1件。
P_G83niooL3PfKouUpGBaA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 20 and 26 February, one new WPV1 case was reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 6 in Chad, 5 in Ethiopia and 2 in Yemen. For environmental samples, 13 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 10 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 6 countries: 4 in Germany, 2 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Poland and the United Kingdom.

cySKfmVQceei8CFrRSvb3w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於去年12/19-12/31期間,巴基斯坦報告新增3例WPV1型病例;共2國新增3例cVDPV2,分別為剛果民主共和國2例、南蘇丹1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增52件WPV1型陽性樣本;共3國新增6件cVDPV2型陽性樣本,分別為象牙海岸4件、阿爾及利亞/波蘭各1件。 2024年巴基斯坦累計報告WPV1型67例,剛果民主共和國累計WPV1型9例與cVDPV2型14例,南蘇丹cVDPV2 型10例。
cySKfmVQceei8CFrRSvb3w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–31 December last year, Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported three new cVDPV2 cases: two in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and one in South Sudan. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 52 new WPV1-positive samples. Three countries reported six new cVDPV2-positive samples: four in Côte d'Ivoire, and one each in Algeria and Poland. For 2024, Pakistan cumulatively reported 67 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo cumulatively reported 9 WPV1 cases and 14 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan reported 10 cVDPV2 cases.

F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/12-12/18期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為查德4例、奈及利亞3例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增8件WPV1陽性樣本;共8國新增23件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國7件、英國5件、奈及利亞/南蘇丹各3 件、查德2件、喀麥隆/象牙海岸/芬蘭各1件。 澳洲墨爾本於汙水中檢出VDPV2陽性樣本,經檢測可能與海外接種小兒麻痺活性疫苗人員相關,並於維多利亞州境內持續散播,當局表示當地疫苗接種率高且汙水經有效處理,評估傳播風險為低。
F5sIzm5Rr4eGoqfgVv6TEA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 December, Pakistan reported four new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: four in Chad and three in Nigeria. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported eight new WPV1-positive samples. Eight countries reported 23 new cVDPV2-positive samples: seven in Germany, five in the United Kingdom, three each in Nigeria and South Sudan, two in Chad, and one each in Cameroon, Côte d'Ivoire and Finland. In Australia, VDPV2-positive samples were detected in wastewater in Melbourne. Testing suggests they may be linked to personnel who received live oral polio vaccine overseas, and the virus continues to spread within Victoria State. Authorities state that vaccination coverage in the area is high and wastewater is effectively treated, and they assess the transmission risk as low.

Ry_nHw8QL-LR7aLPoygsHQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 12/5-12/11期間,巴基斯坦新增3例WPV1病例;共2國新增7例cVDPV2,分別為奈及利亞5例、查德2例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增15件WPV1陽性樣本;共5國新增11件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為巴勒斯坦6件、吉布地2件、阿爾及利亞/象牙海岸/日各1件。 歐洲更新cVDPV2陽性樣本資訊,英國於12/10發布於倫敦、南部及中部地區檢出4件陽性樣本,德國新增6件陽性樣本,所有樣本皆於11月採集;歐洲迄今累計5國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,經檢驗該地區樣本皆與奈及利亞贊法拉州(Zamfara)病毒株相關,ECDC表示病毒可能由流行地區多次移入或一次移入後於歐洲社區傳播。
Ry_nHw8QL-LR7aLPoygsHQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 5–11 December, Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported seven new cVDPV2 cases: five in Nigeria and two in Chad. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 15 new WPV1-positive samples. Five countries reported 11 new cVDPV2-positive samples: six in Palestine, two in Djibouti, and one each in Algeria, Côte d'Ivoire and Niger. Europe has updated its cVDPV2-positive sample information: the United Kingdom reported on 10 December that four positive samples had been detected in London and in the southern and central regions, and Germany reported six new positive samples; all samples were collected in November. So far, five European countries have detected cVDPV2-positive samples. Testing shows that the samples in this region are all related to the virus strain from Zamfara State, Nigeria. ECDC says the virus may have been introduced to Europe through repeated introductions from endemic areas, or through a single introduction followed by community spread.

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

fzu8i1b55w9en5N7qSG6ig.zh: 越南南部胡志明市疫情持續嚴峻,截至10/13累計報告達1,079例,其中4例死亡,5成病例為5歲以下兒童,該市已透過學校系統加強兒童免疫覆蓋率;該國北部清化省10月初亦爆發疫情,單週新增近40例病例,近7成病例為5歲以下兒童,多數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 西非象牙海岸今年截至10/14累計報告1,287例確診病例,病患多為9歲以下兒童,近9成未接種疫苗或接種史不明;該國前3年病例數約介於1,300至2,000例間。 東非南蘇丹南部瓦拉卜州宣布爆發疫情,截至10/22累計報告88例確診病例,當局已加強疫苗接種。
fzu8i1b55w9en5N7qSG6ig.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam, the outbreak remains severe. As of 13 October, 1,079 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 4 deaths. About half of cases are children under 5 years old, and the city has strengthened children's immunization coverage through the school system. In Thanh Hoa Province in northern Viet Nam, an outbreak also began in early October, with nearly 40 new cases in a single week; nearly 70% of cases are children under 5, and most cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history.

Côte d'Ivoire, in West Africa: As of 14 October this year, 1,287 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, mostly children under 9 years old; nearly 90% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. The country's case numbers in the previous three years ranged from about 1,300 to 2,000.

South Sudan, in East Africa: Warrap State in southern South Sudan has announced an outbreak. As of 22 October, 88 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, and authorities have strengthened vaccination.

DU05jp7HiFBoY5FsV-fdgg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/26-10/2期間,共2國新增6例WPV1病例,分別為阿富汗/巴基斯坦各3例;剛果民主共和國新增2例cVDPV1病例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增4件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗3件、巴基斯坦1件;共2國新增2件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為象牙海岸/日各1件。

The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 2 new cVDPV1 cases. For environmental samples, 2 countries reported 4 new WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 3 and Pakistan 1. Also, 2 countries reported 2 new cVDPV2-positive samples: Côte d'Ivoire and Japan 1 each.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年截至9/26累計報告21萬8,258例病例,其中19,454例確診,2,968例死亡(CFR:1.25%),以剛果民主共和國8.5萬餘例、衣索比亞2.7萬餘例最多,另有蒲隆地、摩洛哥、奈及利亞、布吉納法索及索馬利亞報告1萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,19國報告數十至5千例不等。 越南南部胡志明市疫情上升,9月底單週新增近百例病例,自疫情爆發(時間不明)截至9/26累計報告達743例,多為5歲以下兒童,當局表示該市之免疫覆蓋率於各地區差異大,目前已超過72%;另報載該國中、北部省份疫情亦在上升。
Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
